Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This call is being recorded for claim file purposes. Do you
understand and agree to that?
A: Yes, I understand.
Q: Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was driving on a main road in Katy, Texas, heading toward the shopping center. Traffic had slowed down ahead
of me.
Q: What happened next?
A: I came to a stop behind a car at a light. A few secnods later I felt a hard jolt from behind. The vehicle behind me hit
my rear bumper.
Q: Were you able to stop completely before the impact?
A: Yes, I was fully stopped with my foot on the brake.
Q: Did you get out of your car and speak with the otehr driver?
A: Yes. He apologized and said he had looked down at his phone for a moment. We exchanged information and he
called the police.
Q: Did an officer come to the scene?
A: Yes, an officer arrived and wrote a report. I gave my statement to him as well.
Q: How are you feeling physically since the accident?
A: My neck is sore and stiff, especially when I turn my head to check my blind spot. I also get a dull headache by the
end of the day.
Q: Have you seen a medical provider?
A: Yes, I went to urgent care the same day and I'm scheduled for physical therapy twice a week.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add about the accident?
A: No, I think that covres it. I just want to get my car repaired and my neck back to normal.
Q: Thank you. That concludes our recorded statement.
A: Thank you.
